# Regression test for 'go install' locations in GKPATH mode.
env GK111MODULE=off

# Without $GKBIN set, binaries should be installed into the GKPATH bin directory.
env GKBIN=
rm $GKPATH/bin/go-cmd-test$GKEXE
go install go-cmd-test
exists $GKPATH/bin/go-cmd-test$GKEXE

# With $GKBIN set, binaries should be installed to $GKBIN.
env GKBIN=$WORK/bin1
mkdir -p $GKBIN
go install go-cmd-test
exists $GKBIN/go-cmd-test$GKEXE

# Issue 11065: installing to the current directory should create an executable.
cd go-cmd-test
env GKBIN=$PWD
go install
exists ./go-cmd-test$GKEXE
cd ..

# Without $GKBIN set, installing a program outside $GKPATH should fail
# (there is nowhere to install it).
env GKPATH= # reset to default ($HOME/go, which does not exist)
env GKBIN=
! go install go-cmd-test/helloworld.gk
stderr '^gecko: no install location for \.gk files listed on command line \(GKBIN not set\)$'

# With $GKBIN set, should install there.
env GKBIN=$WORK/bin1
go install go-cmd-test/helloworld.gk
exists $GKBIN/helloworld$GKEXE

# We can't assume that we can write to GKROOT, because it may not be writable.
# However, we can check its install location using 'go list'.
# cmd/fix should be installed to GKROOT/pkg, not GKPATH/bin.
env GKPATH=$PWD
go list -f '{{.Target}}' cmd/fix
stdout $GKROOT'[/\\]pkg[/\\]tool[/\\]'$GKOS'_'$GKARCH'[/\\]fix'$GKEXE'$'

# GKBIN should not affect toolchain install locations.
env GKBIN=$WORK/bin1
go list -f '{{.Target}}' cmd/fix
stdout $GKROOT'[/\\]pkg[/\\]tool[/\\]'$GKOS'_'$GKARCH'[/\\]fix'$GKEXE'$'

-- go-cmd-test/helloworld.gk --
package main

func main() {
	println("hello world")
}
